import json, random, sys, importlib.util
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import gen, ref
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("main", "/workspace/submission/main.py")
main = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(main)

def close(a,b):
    if type(a) is dict: return set(a)==set(b) and all(close(a[k],b[k]) for k in a)
    if type(a) is list: return type(b) is list and len(a)==len(b) and all(close(x,y) for x,y in zip(a,b))
    if type(a) is float: return type(b) in (int,float) and abs(a-b)<=1e-9
    return type(a) is type(b) and a==b

seed=int(sys.argv[1]); N=int(sys.argv[2]); maxcore=int(sys.argv[3]) if len(sys.argv)>3 else 7
rng=random.Random(seed)
tested=0; skipped=0; zero=0; cores={}; rounds=0; loops=0
while tested<N:
    data=gen.gen(rng, maxcore=maxcore)
    if data is None:
        skipped+=1; continue
    try: exp=ref.solve(data)
    except AssertionError: skipped+=1; continue
    if exp.get('error')=='zero-partition': zero+=1
    else:
        nc=sum(1 for l in exp['links'] if l['round']==0)
        cores[nc]=cores.get(nc,0)+1
        rounds=max([l['round'] for l in exp['links']]+[0])
        loops+=sum(1 for q in exp['queries'] if q['status']=='loop')
    got=main.solve(json.loads(json.dumps(data)))
    tested+=1
    if not close(exp,got):
        print("MISMATCH"); print(json.dumps(data,indent=1)); print(json.dumps(exp,indent=1)); print(json.dumps(got,indent=1)); sys.exit(1)
print("tested",tested,"skipped",skipped,"zero",zero,"coredist",sorted(cores.items()),"maxround",rounds,"loops",loops)
EOF
